jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering.  

Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. 

 

Wat ga je doen?  

Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt.

Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken.

Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk.

Continu leren is geen optie, maar de norm
Technologie staat niet stil, en jij ook niet. Bij PuurData is training verplicht. Je blijft op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen, denk aan Elastic, AI-integraties en nieuwe dataplatformen, en past die kennis direct toe in klantprojecten.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ondernemende professional die weinig sturing nodig heeft. Je denkt vanuit de eindgebruiker en streeft naar maximale klanttevredenheid zonder kwaliteit en veiligheid uit het oog te verliezen. Dankzij jouw analytisch vermogen zie je snel de kern van een probleem en kom je met creatieve, structurele oplo ssingen. Je kunt technische keuzes helder onderbouwen en klanten daarin meenemen, ook als het complex is. Daarin mag je best een tikkeltje eigenwijs zijn.


Nog geen doorgewinterde expert?

Geen probleem. Als je leergierig bent en en affiniteit hebt met data, komen we graag met je in contact.

Persoonlijke vaardigheden:

  • Analytisch sterk, je ziet snel verbanden in data en datastructuren

  • Leergierig en gedreven om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen

  • Zelfstandig maar samenwerkingsgericht, je pakt door zonder dat iemand je hoeft aan te sturen

  • Communicatief vaardig, je vertaalt technische keuzes naar begrijpelijke taal voor klanten

  • Probleemoplossend, je zoekt structurele oplossingen in plaats van tijdelijke fixes

Professionele vaardigheden:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau in een technische of data-gerelateerde richting

  • 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring in data engineering of een vergelijkbare consultancy rol

  • Ervaring met ETL/ELT processen, data modeling en data pipelines

Pré:

  • Affiniteit met of kennis van Elastic, SQL of vergelijkbare data-platformen

  • Ervaring met data orchestration, data lakes of dashboarding tools

  • Kennis van cloud omgevingen zoals AWS of Azure

  • Begrijpt hoe data-architectuur bijdraagt aan AI-toepassingen en procesautomatisering


Waarom werken bij PuurData?

Je krijgt de vrijheid om je eigen werkweek in te richten en werkt aan uitdagende projecten bij uiteenlopende klanten, geen saaie repeterende klussen. Je werkt in een platte organisatie waar jouw mening telt en er snel geschakeld wordt. Daarnaast bieden we een salaris passend bij jouw ervaring, pensioen zonder eigen bijdrage en volop ruimte om door te groeien.

Herken jij jezelf hierin? We horen graag van je.

jobs.description:
Analyseren, (functioneel) testen, debuggen… Waar houd jij je als test engineer bij ons eigenlijk niet mee bezig!?

Als test engineer is iedere werkdag anders. De complexe producten die wij maken voor onze klanten, maken gebruik van proces- en functionele testers. Uitval hiervan wordt geanalyseerd en testers worden gedebugged. Dit wordt in samenwerking met ons Test Development team gedaan, die onze testers hebben ontwikkeld, gebouwd én vrijgegeven. Het grootste gedeelte van je werkdag ben je bezig met praktische en analytische werkzaamheden.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden als test engineer:

  • Testen van prototypes: in een losse testopstelling op je werkbank meten.

  • Debuggen/functioneel testen in Labview: bijvoorbeeld na uitval op de functionele tester.

  • Sustainable analyseren: uitzoeken wat er is gebeurd, waarom is dit gebeurd en hoe we dit in de toekomst kunnen voorkomen.

  • Reparatie van uitgevallen producten; uitval na o.a. AOI, Flying probe of functionele testers of retouren vanuit de klant.

  • Interne overleggen: bijvoorbeeld met je collega’s van de afdeling Quality, Engineering etc.

  • Technisch challengen: niet alleen bij Benchmark collega’s, maar soms ook bij de klant.

Jij zorgt in alles wat je doet voor de juiste analyses en verwerking hiervan. Hierdoor worden afwijkingen gefilterd en gesignaleerd, worden root-causes vastgesteld en opgelost en blijft het productieproces continu verbeteren.

Werken bij Benchmark betekent werken in een dynamische werkomgeving. Je werkt in een zelfstandig team waar jouw initiatieven en ideeën zeer op prijs worden gesteld. Het team bestaat uit 13 collega’s en is een hechte groep waarin iedereen bereid is om elkaar te helpen.

Jij draagt bij aan het voorbereiden, vastleggen en verbeteren van productieprocessen door onder andere werkinstructies op te stellen, technische documentatie te beheren en product- en procesgegevens te verwerken.   • Je werkt in een multifunctioneel klantenteam, waarbij je een of meerdere Industrialisatie Engineers ondersteunt bij de introductie van nieuwe producten (NPI).

Jij krijgt de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen met nieuwe productintroducties (NPI’s), technische documentatie en productieprocessen binnen onze high-tech manufacturing omgeving!

 

Waar maak jij het verschil?

Je ontlast engineer bij uitvoerende werkzaamheden binnen NPI-projecten. Hierdoor neemt niet alleen efficiëntie toe, maar komt er ook meer ruimte voor procesoptimalisatie en (technische-) verbeterprojecten. Kortom; jij leert niet alleen van ons, wij leren ook van, en dankzij, jou!

 

 

Wat biedt Benchmark?

Je krijgt de kans om naast je studie relevante praktijkervaring op te doen binnen onze internationale high-tech organisatie. Je werkt samen met ervaren manufacturing engineers en krijgt inzicht in hoe nieuwe elektronische producten worden geïntroduceerd in een high-tech productieomgeving. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, nieuwe vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en de kennis uit je opleiding direct in de praktijk toe te passen. Je komt terecht in een informele en collegiale werkomgeving waar samenwerking, initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Zo bouw je niet alleen mee aan innovatieve producten, maar ook aan je eigen professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Goed salaris: €3.064,- bruto per maand op fulltime basis.

  • Vakantie: geniet van 40 vrije dagen per jaar op fulltime basis (27 vakantiedagen én 13 ATV-dagen).

  • Ruimte voor groei- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden: bijvoorbeeld door deel te nemen aan één van de vele trainingen van onze Benchmark Academy.

  • Flexibele werktijden: zolang jij zorgt dat je werk af is, is er bij ons de mogelijkheid om op een flexibele manier je werktijden in te delen.

  • Deelname aan ons BE-Fit programma: sporten met collega’s op kosten van Benchmark. Samen hebben we al gekickbokst, cross-fit gedaan en padelclinics gevolgd.

Wat zien wij graag in onze toekomstige collega?

  • Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Elektrotechniek, Electrical Engineering en je bent 1 tot 2 dagen per week beschikbaar.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed.

Over ons

Benchmark in Almelo maakt onderdeel uit van de multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., een beursgenoteerde onderneming op het gebied van het vervaardigen van elektronica en het leveren van diensten richting original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s). 

Bij ons werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd.

Wereldwijd heeft Benchmark Electronics Inc. momenteel 23 vestigingen. Op onze vestiging in Almelo werken we samen met ongeveer 650 collega’s.

jobs.title: Medior C++ Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

As a Medior C++ Engineer, you will take ownership of software components within our hardware-integrated systems. You will design, implement, and improve robust C++ software that interacts with multiple subsystems, and real-time environments. You will collaborate closely with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers to ensure system reliability, maintainability, and performance.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know Vitestro's software architecture, hardware-integrated systems, and development processes. You build an understanding of how our software interacts with different subsystems and start contributing to the design, implementation, and improvement of software components in modern C++ (C++17/20).

Working closely with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers, you become familiar with our state-machine-based logic, DDS communication protocols, and Linux and real-time environments. You contribute to debugging, automated testing, and code reviews while building the knowledge needed to take ownership of software components.

After your first month you will be able to contribute to the velocity of the team by working on new features in the scope of the motion team. You will be able to solve complex integration issues coming from production and the field.

This is what success looks like

After 12 months, you have taken ownership of software components within our hardware-integrated systems. You confidently design, implement, and maintain robust C++ software that interacts with multiple subsystems and real-time environments.

You actively contribute to improving the existing software architecture, ensuring maintainability, scalability, and performance. You design and maintain structured state-machine-based logic, integrate evolving hardware components into the software stack, and contribute to system-level design discussions and technical decisions.

You work effectively with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers to debug complex issues across software and hardware boundaries. You have contributed to improving testability and automated verification strategies, actively participate in code reviews, and help raise software quality standards.

After your first year, you will own significant nontrivial features and parts of the code-base of the team. You will be a key knowledge holder of the implementation of the motion software unit as well as accuracy calibrations and verifications. You actively engage in building the roadmap for the coming years together with other engineers.


What You'll Bring:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 4–7 years of experience developing C++ software in a professional environment.

  • Proven experience designing and maintaining production-level software systems.

  • Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20).

  • Experience structuring code for maintainability and scalability.

  • Experience with automated testing.

  • Experience working in Linux environments.

  • Strong debugging skills in complex systems.

  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with hardware–software integration.

  • Familiarity with DDS or similar pub/sub communication frameworks.

  • Experience working in real-time or near real-time systems.

  • Python scripting experience.

What we offer:

  • Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away

As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements.

After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. Skytree is voortgekomen uit de European Space Agency (ESA). We zijn een internationaal team van bijzonder getalenteerde wetenschappers, ingenieurs en business professionals, ondersteund door een ervaren managementteam. Onze werkcultuur kenmerkt zich door een dynamische en slimme benadering van ondernemen, een open en begripvolle houding naar anderen, en de drive om de grenzen van het mogelijke te verleggen.

Nu we ons project portfolio in Nederland verder uitbreiden, zijn we op zoek naar een gedreven en leergierige stagiair(e) voor ons Project Development-team in Amsterdam.

Als stagiair(e) Business Development voor Nederland ondersteun je het team bij het identificeren en ontwikkelen van deze kansen — van het eerste contact tot een project partnerschap. Dit is een praktische, commerciële rol: je brengt klanten in kaart, benadert prospects en helpt de pijplijn op te bouwen die de technologie van Skytree in de praktijk brengt.

Marktontwikkeling & kansen in kaart brengen

  • Ondersteunen van marktonderzoek en het in kaart brengen van kansen in Nederland, en het kwalificeren van potentiële projectpartners en afnemers.

Ondersteuning bij projectontwikkeling

  • Meewerken aan projectvoorstellen, businesscases en haalbaarheidsanalyses voor DAC-installaties.

  • Klantbezoeken en presenteren van ons product.

  • Bijhouden en actualiseren van de strategische project pijplijn van Skytree over de verschillende projectfases (stage gates).

  • Samenwerken met de teams business finance, productontwikkeling en commercie om projecten van idee tot realisatie te brengen.

Commercial intelligence

  • Volgen van de ontwikkelingen in Nederland.

  • Ondersteunen bij het voorbereiden van commerciële presentaties, pitchmateriaal en partnerbriefings.

  • Bijdragen aan het groeiende netwerk van Skytree in Nederland door relevante contacten te identificeren en te benaderen.


Wat we zoeken

  • Een masterstudent of recent afgestudeerde in Bedrijfskunde, Economie, Duurzaamheid, Energie of een verwant vakgebied.

  • Sterke analytische en onderzoeksvaardigheden — je zet marktdata om in bruikbare inzichten.

  • Uitstekende schriftelijke en mondelinge communicatievaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels.

  • Een ondernemende houding en oprechte interesse in klimaattechnologie en de energietransitie.

  • Je voelt je thuis in een dynamisch, internationaal team.

  • Ervaring in commercie, consultancy of projectontwikkeling is een plus.

2. Amélioration continue et performance industrielle

  • Déploiement des outils Lean : contribuer à la démarche d’amélioration continue de la ligne à travers les méthodes 5S, SMED, Kaizen et AMDEC Process.

  • Accompagnement du changement : former et sensibiliser les équipes aux nouveaux standards, aux réglages des procédés et aux bonnes pratiques de conduite des installations.

  • Analyse des risques : contribuer aux études de sécurité des procédés, notamment aux analyses HAZOP, aux analyses d’accidents et de presque-accidents ainsi qu’à la prise en compte des risques ATEX et liés aux poussières.

AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital, créée en 2007. Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Data Engineering, IA générative et LLM. Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets à forte valeur ajoutée pour faire de la Data un véritable levier de transformation.

Nous intervenons auprès de clients aux secteurs d’activité variés, sur des missions qui combinent enjeux techniques, Data, IA et transformation opérationnelle. Selon votre profil et vos affinités, vous pourrez contribuer à des projets allant de la conception de prototypes jusqu’à la mise en production de solutions IA robustes, sécurisées et maintenables.

Nos clients évoluent notamment dans les secteurs du Luxe, du Retail, des Télécoms, de la Banque, de l’Assurance et de l’Industrie. Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques techniques variées.

Quelques exemples de projets AI Engineer

  • Conception et développement d’agents autonomes pour automatiser des processus métiers : conception de workflows complexes, notamment dans l’industrie ou la relation client, dans lesquels des agents IA enchaînent des tâches, prennent des décisions et interagissent avec les outils et les données internes de l’entreprise.

  • Conception et orchestration de plateformes multi-agents : mise en place d’architectures dans lesquelles plusieurs agents IA spécialisés collaborent pour résoudre des problématiques complexes, par exemple en combinant recherche d’informations, synthèse et exécution de code, afin d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle.

  • Déploiement de plateformes Cloud : conception et déploiement d’environnements permettant de développer, sécuriser, superviser et faire évoluer des solutions IA.

  • Évaluation, observabilité et gouvernance des solutions IA : mise en place de dispositifs permettant de suivre la qualité, les coûts, les performances et la sécurité des applications IA, afin d’en garantir la fiabilité et la pérennité.

Nous recherchons un profil de formation supérieure (Bac+5) en informatique, ingénierie logicielle, data ou domaine équivalent.

Vous avez déjà participé à des projets d’industrialisation de solutions IA, idéalement autour du RAG, des agents IA, des environnements Cloud et de la mise en production.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne autonome, pragmatique et curieuse, capable de comprendre un besoin métier pour le traduire en solution technique concrète. Une bonne maîtrise du français et un niveau d’anglais technique sont attendus.

  • Le développement d’agents IA, de workflows et d’applications RAG.

  • L’intégration d’outils, d’APIs et de données d’entreprise.

  • Le développement d’APIs, de serveurs MCP et de services backend.

  • L’industrialisation et le déploiement de solutions dans des environnements Cloud.

  • La mise en place de tests, d’évaluations, de dispositifs d’observabilité et de sécurité.

  • La documentation des solutions et le partage des bonnes pratiques avec les équipes.

Pas besoin de maîtriser l’ensemble de ces technologies pour nous rejoindre ! Nous recherchons avant tout des profils solides en développement, curieux et motivés, avec l’envie d’apprendre et de monter en compétences sur les sujets d’IA générative, d’industrialisation et de Cloud.

  • Langages & frameworks : Python, SQL, Node.js, FastAPI, LangChain, ADK, LlamaIndex, APIs d’IA générative (OpenAI, Anthropic…).

  • DevOps & industrialisation : Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Git.

  • Plateformes Data & Cloud : Google Cloud, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Dataiku.

L’objectif : vous permettre de développer progressivement votre expertise, de découvrir de nouvelles technologies et de construire un parcours professionnel qui vous ressemble.

Chez AVISIA, nous accordons autant d’importance à votre évolution professionnelle qu’à votre épanouissement au quotidien.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Creative Strategist (gn) @ Female Health Consumer Startup, London
jobs.description:
About DITTO

DITTO is a science-led brand redefining menstrual health. As a fast-growing, VC-backed business, we're scaling a new standard in menstrual wellbeing — empowering anyone with cycle symptoms to understand, support and optimise their health every day, not just during their period. Developed by female scientists and powered by biotechnology, the Cycle Supplement is backed by over 100 clinical trials and validated in its own clinical trial.

Beyond the capsule, DITTO is building a movement — combining credible science, thoughtful design, and inclusive storytelling to change how menstrual health is perceived and supported. As we grow, performance creative will be central to how we convert attention into action.

About the role

You will sit at the intersection of data and creativity — turning science into content that stops the scroll and drives sales. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will define what makes a potential customer stop, engage, and convert — and then build the systems to do it at scale.

You are not just briefing others. You are embedded in the work from the first concept through to post-production feedback and the next iteration. If you are equally energised by diving into data and dreaming up ideas, this role was built for you.

Performance creative strategy

  • Own creative strategy across Meta, TikTok and YouTube with clear KPIs across ROAS, conversion and scalable growth.

  • Develop creative frameworks that harness DITTO's scientific credibility to build trust and drive purchase decisions.

  • Analyse performance data to surface winning signals, identify trends and shape the next generation of assets.

  • Build and own a structured testing roadmap — challenging creative hypotheses, running experiments and scaling what works.

  • Track and report on hook rate, watch time, CTR, CVR, and ROAS — using data to drive every creative decision.

Hands-on execution

  • Lead end-to-end creative development: concepting, scripting, storyboarding, briefing, and post-production feedback.

  • Develop high-performing short-form content with a relentless focus on hooks, retention and shareability.

  • Identify repeatable formats and frameworks that can be systematically tested and scaled.

  • Ensure all output balances performance intent with DITTO's brand identity — science-led, design-forward and inclusive.

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience in performance marketing or creative strategy, ideally within D2C or the wellness space.

  • Thinks in data and dreams in concepts — equally comfortable interpreting performance metrics as developing bold creative ideas.

  • Deep understanding of Meta & TikTok — the nuances, the algorithms and what actually makes content perform.

  • Can translate complex science into consumer messaging that earns trust and drives action.

  • Proactive, highly organised and thrives in a fast-moving environment where you own your output.

  • Cares about purpose-led brands, women's health and reshaping the conversation around menstrual wellbeing.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have experience in a high-growth startup environment.

  • Have a personal interest in health, nutrition, or scientific innovation.

  • Are familiar with motion design or video editing tools.

jobs.title: Co-Founder & CTO (gn), Industrial Data for AI, Paris
jobs.description:
About FoodLabs

FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch.

About The General Data Corporation

General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale.

Why this is a unique opportunity

AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity.

General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani, you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up.

About the role

  • Supplier intake: Build connectors for where companies actually keep their data: Databases, document stores, ticketing systems, machine logs, and sensor and video archives. 

  • Transaction layer: Own the pipeline, rights evidence, contracts, permissions, audit trail and delivery API.

  • ML and data quality: Build anonymisation across text, tables, images and video, plus re-identification checks, deduplication, quality scoring and tooling that turns raw records into training-ready data. 

  • Delivery and compute: Decide whether data is processed in our cloud or inside the supplier’s environment. Build secure delivery, recurring updates and our GPU infrastructure.

  • Technical direction: Own the architecture and roadmap. Work directly with labs, suppliers and researchers to understand what the system needs to become.

What you need to succeed

  • Data infrastructure at scale: You have built pipelines for large unstructured datasets, such as video, images, sensor logs or documents, at terabyte scale or more.

  • Physical-world data: You have worked with documents, logs, video or sensor streams, ideally in robotics, industrial or autonomous systems and know what embodied AI teams need from data and where it breaks.

  • Sensitive data: You know how to handle personal and confidential data safely. Experience with regulated data is a plus.

  • Technical leadership: You make architectural decisions, explain them clearly and raise the engineering bar as the team grows.

  • Hands-on Builder: You have taken a product, platform or open-source project from 0 to 1 that others relied on, and you still write code and own the critical paths.

  • Founder mindset: You care about the outcome, not the title. You form strong views, test them quickly and are comfortable owning technical, product and operational problems.

  • Location: Paris preferred. English required; French is a plus.

Please note: As a co-founder, you take a real stake in what we build. The compensation is a founder salary, and your upside grows with the company through your equity. Come build the infrastructure between AI and the world's data with us!

jobs.title: Agentic Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
jobs.description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.

About the Role

As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath.

Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows.

You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product.

Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will operate in an agentic way by default, using coding agents as a core part of how you design, build, test and ship software. You'll develop the harnesses and workflows that allow you to delegate and parallelise work effectively, increasing what a small engineering team can deliver. This requires strong coding fundamentals and the judgement to review, challenge and take responsibility for everything that reaches production.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through.

What You’ll Work On

Your first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops.

  • Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors.

  • Agentic engineering workflows: build and refine the harnesses, tooling and workflows that enable coding agents to work effectively across the development lifecycle, from implementation and testing to debugging and deployment.

  • Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend.

  • Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation.

  • Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars.

  • Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management.

  • European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models.

  • Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private.

The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well.

Our Stack

Our backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo.

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and LiteLLM.

  • Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq.

  • Frontend: Next.js, React and TypeScript.

  • Cloud and infrastructure: Scaleway, Terraform and Kubernetes for GPU workloads.

  • Auth and secrets: Zitadel, Secret Manager and KMS.

  • Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools.

You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires.

About You

You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step. You naturally look for ways to multiply your output through agentic workflows, rather than approaching every engineering task as something to execute manually.

We are looking for:

  • Experience building and operating production systems: several years of backend engineering with real users, typically three to six, and meaningful ownership of what you shipped.

  • Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus.

  • Agentic engineering as a default way of working: you have hands-on experience using coding agents as a core part of your engineering workflow. You know how to break down problems, delegate and parallelise tasks, provide the right context and build effective agentic workflows. Crucially, you have the technical depth to review, debug and take ownership of the resulting code.

  • Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure.

  • Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out.

  • A working understanding of ML systems: familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, evals, model serving and fine-tuning. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming and token costs is a strong plus.

  • A disciplined approach to measurement: you benchmark changes, question assumptions and use evidence to understand whether an improvement holds up.

  • Initiative and drive: you enjoy getting deep into a problem, finding a way forward and putting in the work to make it happen.

  • This is an experienced individual-contributor role, with ownership of the capabilities you build and close collaboration across the founding team.

  • Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

Why Join

At this stage, platform engineering decisions have a direct influence on the product and how quickly the team can build it. You will work close to the founder and CTO, with room to shape the systems you own and see the results of your work first-hand.

The challenge spans AI infrastructure, distributed systems, security and cost efficiency. You will build across those boundaries, take real responsibility early and receive a meaningful equity package in the company you help develop.

We are competing with teams that have more people, more funding and an earlier start. Our approach depends on technical depth, focused decisions and the drive to turn them into working software. We believe agentic engineering can fundamentally change what a small, technically strong team is capable of building, and we're looking for people who want to push that approach forward. For someone who enjoys a demanding build, close collaboration and visible impact, there is a lot to get involved in.

This is a full-time role, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Head / Senior Director of Sales – Central Europe
jobs.description:
About Cyclomedia


At Cyclomedia, our mission is to digitise the outside world with precision. Our geospatial technology turns street-level and aerial imagery into data and insights that cities, municipalities, utilities, telecom operators and infrastructure owners use to plan and run their operations more safely, efficiently and sustainably.

Backed by private equity investor Volpi Capital, we operate across the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, Poland and the United States. Our customers range from Kommunen, Länder and federal authorities to Stadtwerke, utilities and telecom infrastructure companies.

Our culture is driven by curiosity and innovation, guided by impact and purpose, and built on collaboration, trust, transparency and accountability. We believe diverse perspectives drive innovation, and we are committed to building a team that reflects different backgrounds, identities and experiences. We welcome applications from everyone.

Job Summary


Germany is one of Cyclomedia's most important markets and a key pillar of our growth strategy. As Head / Senior Director of Sales, Central Europe, you will lead the next phase of our growth across DACH and Poland as a hands-on sales leader who owns the pipeline, the team and the plan.

You will build on a strong foundation: an established sales team and a base of strong reference customers. Your mandate is to take this to the next level by building a predictable, scalable sales engine with full visibility across pipeline, accounts and forecast.

Around 75% of your time goes into hands-on sales leadership, and around 25% into business development and growth strategy. You will be a member of the commercial leadership team, alongside the regional VPs and the VP Marketing.


Job Duties

Pipeline and forecast

  • Lead the weekly pipeline review across every rep, deal and stage.

  • Drive qualification rigour from first contact to close, ensuring forecasts are built on well-qualified opportunities.

  • Deliver a reliable monthly and quarterly forecast with clear insight into drivers and variance.

  • Be a hands-on CRM user and champion high standards of data quality and accuracy across the team.

  • Identify deals that need momentum early, create urgency and engage personally where it adds the most value.

Team leadership

  • Set clear, measurable expectations for every seller, supported by structured 1:1s, deal reviews and coaching.

  • Develop team performance through coaching, enablement and effective talent management.

  • Lead the team through growth and change with a style that inspires people to follow.

  • Maintain transparent, proactive communication with senior leadership, raising topics early and always with a recommended next step.

Customers and key accounts

  • Personally own key accounts and strategic deals as a player-coach.

  • Build senior relationships across Kommunen, Länder and Bund, Stadtwerke and utilities, and infrastructure and telecom accounts.

  • Lead or steer public tenders (RFQ / RFP, Vergaberecht, framework agreements) together with pre-sales.

Growth strategy and business development

  • Build and own the growth plan for Germany, DACH and Poland: where the next 12–24 months of revenue will come from, by vertical, segment and channel.

  • Translate the plan into quarterly targets, headcount needs and channel priorities, and keep it current as a live commitment.

  • Align public-sector buying cycles with the company's annual planning cadence.

  • Identify white space in the existing customer base and the wider market.

  • Bring structured market intelligence to the commercial leadership team, always with a recommendation.

  • Orchestrate pre-sales, marketing and product through influence and collaboration.


Job Requirements:

  • 10+ years in B2B sales, including 4+ years leading sales teams against revenue targets; around 15 years of overall experience is a useful guide.

  • A hands-on operating style: you personally run the forecast, the weekly cadence, the pipeline and key accounts.

  • Public-sector exposure: familiarity with tender mechanics, procurement rules and public-sector buying timelines.

  • Experience in data or technology solution sales, ideally geospatial or adjacent technology, or data-driven solutions with a long, considered buying cycle.

  • Experience in a larger, structured corporate environment, combined with the motivation to apply that discipline in a company where your impact is direct and visible.

  • Leadership people follow: you set high standards, coach people to meet them and make sound people decisions.

  • Fluent German and fluent English.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling across several verticals such as government, utilities / Stadtwerke, telecom and infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with Vermessung / Kataster and municipal planning buyers.

  • A regional growth plan you built and executed with measurable accountability.

  • Experience running several sales motions at once: direct enterprise, public sector, channel / partner and inbound.

  • Hands-on knowledge of public procurement, including RFPs, tenders and multi-year framework agreements.

  • Experience aligning public-sector sales cycles with the planning cadence of an investor-backed growth business.

  • Polish language skills.

  • Based in the Wetzlar / Frankfurt region

Benefits

  • Real ownership: a clear growth mandate, genuine freedom to shape the plan, and a seat on the commercial leadership team.

  • A strong starting point: an experienced team and solid reference customers.

  • Competitive package: attractive base salary plus performance-related variable pay.

  • Company car.

  • 28 days of annual leave, plus public holidays.

  • Supplementary health insurance: treatment by senior physicians and a private room, fully paid by Cyclomedia.

  • Company pension (Direktversicherung) with an employer contribution.

  • Learning and development: team coaching, online courses and individual training.

  • Team events: hiking, karaoke, treasure hunts and wine tastings are all part of how we get together.

Ready to lead the growth of one of our most important markets? Apply now and help us bring Cyclomedia's geospatial insights to the organisations shaping Central Europe.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

jobs.title: Market Product Lead
jobs.description:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

The role

You will own the peptide and protein platform as a commercial product: the market analysis behind it, the target product profiles it is judged against, the decisions about what we build and license first, the go to market strategy and the positioning that partners hear. You will sit between our model and science teams and our business development function, and you will be accountable for the peptide portfolio having a defined buyer, a defensible claim and a credible price.

Key responsibilities

Market and competitive intelligence

  • Build and maintain a rigorous view of the peptide/protein therapeutics landscape by segment, indication and modality, mechanism trends and delivery technologies.

  • Track and interpret competitor activity across AI-enabled discovery platforms, peptide/protein-focused biotechs, screening technology providers, and internal pharmaceutical capability, and translate it into implications for our product road map and and go to market execution.

  • Maintain a live map of deal structures, comparables and valuation benchmarks in platform licensing and co-development, and advise on where our agreements should sit.

  • Bring the outside in: run structured voice-of-customer work with pharmaceutical R&D leaders, and turn it into prioritised, written requirements rather than anecdotes.

Target product profiles and programme definition

  • Author and defend target product profiles for internal programmes, specifying which properties are differentiated in the market and define evidence needs.

  • Translate partner-supplied target product profiles into feasible research plans in collaboration with scientific leadership, including honest assessments of what our platform can and cannot address today.

  • Define stage gates and go or no-go criteria for peptide programmes, and make the recommendation when a programme should stop.

Productization and roadmap

  • Decide, on evidence, which platform capabilities become licensable products and in what sequence, balancing near-term revenue against durable differentiation.

  • Own the peptide/product product roadmap end to end, agreeing priorities with model, data and science teams and holding the line on scope.

  • Define packaging and commercial models for each offering, including access arrangements, bespoke model fine-tuning on partner data, co-development structures and asset-level licensing.

  • Specify the data we need from partners in order to improve, and turn broad offers of collaboration into precise, written requests.

Positioning, evidence and partner engagement

  • Responsible for partner engagement and revenue generation in collaboration with the Business Development team.

  • Build the peptide narrative and the materials behind it: capability maps, benchmark summaries, validation packages and competitive comparisons that hold up under scrutiny from senior pharmaceutical scientists.

  • Set and enforce the standard for external claims, ensuring that what we say about validation, benchmarks and limitations is accurate, consistent across documents, and appropriately caveated.

  • Support business development through partner meetings, scientific exchanges, conferences and diligence processes, acting as the credible bridge between technical and commercial conversations.

  • Work with scientific and legal colleagues on intellectual property strategy, freedom-to-operate considerations and novelty positioning for designed molecules.

Essential experience and skills

  • Ten or more years in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with substantial exposure to peptide, protein or biologics therapeutics in discovery, development, product strategy or business development.

  • Demonstrable command of what makes peptides difficult as drugs: proteolytic stability, oral and systemic exposure, receptor selectivity and off-target risk, immunogenicity, formulation and manufacturability, and the trade-offs between them.

  • A track record of shaping and closing commercial partnerships, licensing agreements or platform deals with pharmaceutical companies, or of owning commercial strategy for a platform sold into pharmaceutical R&D.

  • Proven ability to author target product profiles, competitive assessments and commercial cases that senior stakeholders act on.

  • Credibility in both directions: able to hold a substantive technical discussion with computational and experimental scientists, and a commercial discussion with a vice-president of platform technologies, without over-claiming in either.

  • Comfort operating with incomplete evidence, and the discipline to distinguish clearly between what is validated, what is promising and what is aspiration.

  • Excellent written English. A great deal of this role is producing documents that must be right.

  • Travel including to represent Basecamp Research at clients and industry meetings

Desirable experience

  • Experience in metabolic disease, immunology, anti-infectives or another therapeutic area with an active peptide pipeline.

  • Familiarity with macrocyclic peptides, peptidomimetics, non-canonical amino acids, conjugation strategies or oral delivery technologies.

  • Direct experience of AI-enabled drug discovery platforms, from either the platform side or the pharmaceutical side of a partnership.

  • A postgraduate degree in a life science, chemistry or a related business areas, or equivalent depth acquired in industry

Compensation and benefits

What we offer in return

  • Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics..

  • Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points.

  • High Growth: We truly believe in investing our people we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions so strong that means most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike to work scheme, life insurance, and more.

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.

  • AI therapy: a voice agent delivering structured CBT over the phone to adults with depression and anxiety, with licensed clinicians overseeing care. It is live with Medicare patients and growing every week.

  • AI assessment: a conversational agent that US healthcare organisations configure to assess patients, administer clinical questionnaires, detect risk and recommend the right treatment programme, so patients reach the right care faster.

  • Lead eval-driven development: evaluation suites, simulated patients and LLM-as-judge autolabellers validated against clinician labels, so we ship with confidence and catch regressions before patients do.

  • Productionise ML models that optimise product KPIs, such as triage accuracy, treatment completion and recovery rates, and identify the causal factors that drive them.

  • Strong architectural skills with experience designing scalable, production-grade systems for machine learning applications.

  • A solid understanding of statistical principles in the context of LLM evaluation and user activity analytics.

jobs.title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
jobs.description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading.

About the Role

We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast.

Every bet runs through the same gates. If a bet misses its gates, you kill it with evidence and move to the next one. If it works and you're running it well, you don't have to hand it off. You scale into owning the category, with supply, acquisition and ops building out under you. Think of this seat as a venture builder inside Fleek.

One thing this is not. We're not building a sales team or a sales culture, and this is not an AE or account manager role with a new title. You'll work directly with the founders and our commercial lead, close to the centre of the company.

What You'll Do

  • Run bets through the gates: take each bet from market research to first suppliers to first GMV to a feasible-or-not call, with win metrics and kill metrics defined before you start.

  • Go where the supply is: get on planes. You'll visit suppliers, graders and rag houses in the markets your bets open up, because this trade is built face to face and the best stock never gets listed anywhere.

  • Sell supply into live demand: onboard brands, brokers, graders and wholesalers, then get Fleek's existing buyers transacting on the new inventory. The sell is fast, informal and relationship-led, over WhatsApp and Instagram as often as in a boardroom.

  • Make the kill calls: hold a clear view of unit economics and the competitive landscape on every bet. Double down or cut on evidence, not attachment.

  • Be the ops function, for now: work out importer-of-record structures, duties, freight cost and last mile for each new flow.

  • Ride the AI infrastructure: our acquisition team has spent months building the agentic outreach and enrichment engine. You'll plug your bets into it and extend it, rather than building from a blank page or adding headcount.

  • Learn the actual trade: how stock is graded, routed and priced across markets, and who's sitting on good inventory that nobody has approached. You'll get deep in it fast.

What You Bring

  • Zero-to-one is your natural habitat. You've built something from nothing as a founder, an early employee or the person who started a new line inside an existing company. You've operated without a playbook and you didn't wait for one.

  • Operator and commercial in one person. You build the machine and you carry the number. You're not pure strategy and you're not pure sales, and you're comfortable being measured on GMV within your first quarter.

  • AI fluency. You work with agents and automations daily and you'd rather build a workflow than repeat a task.

Strong signals on top of that:

  • An instinct for physical goods. You understand inventory, margins and trading relationships, or you've worked around fashion, resale or marketplaces.

  • Deals you structured yourself, at any size, that didn't exist before you wrote them.

  • Exposure to cross-border trade, logistics or supply chain operations.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience in resale, surplus or secondary-market inventory

  • Experience launching a new market, geography or product line from scratch

  • Established networks in international sourcing markets

What You'll Get

  • Generous equity: being on Fleek means you'll own a part of it

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage

  • A collaborative team in a lovely office in the heart of East London

  • Access to founders. We're a small team and they're heavily involved (and good fun!)

  • Exclusive employee discounts to buy on Fleek

  • Access to borrow any item from our collection of vintage and reworks in the office

  • A disproportionate level of responsibility and the opportunity to drive massive impact

How We Work

Fleek is an in-office company. We're based at Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East). We operate a fully in-person culture at our office in Shoreditch, with trust-based flexibility. We hire adults and trust them to perform.

The Practicalities

  • Location: London HQ, Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East)

  • Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: 200 across three geographies

  • Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Talent Director
jobs.description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

 

The Role

The Talent Director owns how OLIX finds, wins and hires the people who will build it. You will take a talent function built for around 200 people and make it one that carries us confidently to 1,000, across London, Bristol, Austin, San Francisco and Toronto, without lowering the bar on a single hire.

This is a hands on leadership role. You will personally lead our most senior and executive searches, and close people who are not looking. Many of the people we need exist in pools of a few dozen worldwide: III-V device engineers, advanced packaging architects, optical interconnect specialists, AI software engineers, silicon leaders who have taken a chip to production. Hiring them is a precision problem, not a volume one. You will build a team of recruiters as sharp as the engineers they hire, and set an AI strategy for recruiting that changes how we decide, not just how fast we work. The best argument wins here, and we expect you to make it, welcome challenges to it, and change your mind when the evidence says so.

 

Responsibilities

  • Build and scale the talent function from around 200 to 1,000 people: org design, hiring, priorities and operating rhythm, in place before the headcount arrives

  • Lead senior and executive searches directly, including the hires that signal the calibre of people joining OLIX

  • Attract, hire and develop top Recruiters and Sourcers, and hold them to the same bar as our engineers

  • Own the hiring bar: what great looks like for each role family, and how consistently every interviewer applies it

  • Build the playbook for extremely scarce talent: mapping the market, building relationships early, and closing passive candidates

  • Set OLIX's AI strategy for recruiting, deciding where AI improves our judgement and where people need to stay in the loop

  • Own hiring systems, data and metrics, and partner with the exec team on workforce planning, including saying when a plan is not hireable as written

  • Build OLIX's talent brand so the best people in photonics, silicon and AI know who we are

 

Skills & Experience

  • Has built and led a talent function through hyper-growth, from a few hundred people toward 1,000 or beyond, while keeping quality high. This is non-negotiable

  • Has attracted and developed top recruiters, and can name the people who would come with you

  • Has worked where talent density is top 1% (a frontier AI lab, a leading semiconductor or hardware company, or an elite deep tech scale-up) and knows what that bar looks and feels like

  • Has personally led senior and executive searches into niche, extremely limited talent pools

  • A clear point of view on AI in recruiting that goes beyond efficiency, with evidence of putting it into practice

  • Either versed in deep tech already, or curious enough to go deep on product and technology and hold your own with engineers

  • Influences through evidence and clear reasoning, not title, and is comfortable disagreeing directly in a founder-led environment

 

Nice to Have

  • Talent leadership at an AI lab, AI hardware company or semiconductor business

  • Direct experience hiring in photonics, optoelectronics, advanced packaging, silicon or AI software

  • Experience hiring across the UK and US and running a multi-site function

 

Compensation & Equity

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it

  • Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office

  • Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates’ eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

About us

Motorway is the first and largest car-selling marketplace in the UK, connecting private sellers directly with over 8,000 verified dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve market leading prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want to grow their businesses profitably.

Founded in 2017, Motorway's technology-led approach has transformed the car-selling experience. We now facilitate hundreds of thousands of car sales each year, with 2,500 cars in our daily auction. We employ 400+ people across the UK. Valued at over $1bn and backed by leading global technology investors, including Index and Iconiq. Motorway is now entering a critical phase focused on scale, growth and profitability. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth scale-up at a pivotal moment and help shape the services that sit around every car sold on Motorway.

About the job

As Commercial Director of Dealer Solutions, you will own what happens after Motorway's daily auction closes: inspecting and transporting the car, making sure everyone gets paid, and helping dealers fund the stock they buy. Transport, Payments and Dealer Finance are central to Motorway's next phase of growth. They shape how dealers experience Motorway, how much of each transaction we serve, and how we grow revenue beyond the core marketplace. There is significant work to do across all three, with scope to add new dealer solutions over time.

This is a senior commercial leadership role. You will set the strategy, own the P&L for these services and lead experienced specialist teams, bringing commercial clarity, pace and ambition. You will be as comfortable framing an investment case for the executive team as you are working through an operational problem with your team.

You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product and Engineering, as well as a network of external partners that support the delivery of Dealer Solutions. Our dealer base and partnerships are growing, and our Dealer Solutions need to scale ahead of that demand while staying simple and reliable for dealers and sellers.

The Commercial Director reports directly to the Chief Operating Officer, James Wilson, and is part of Motorway's senior leadership team.

Responsibilities

This role is responsible for turning Motorway's Dealer Solutions into a scaled, profitable part of the business. You will set clear priorities, make explicit trade-offs and move between strategy and detail as the situation needs.

Strategy & Commercial Leadership

  • Set the vision, strategy and goals for Transport, Payments and Dealer Finance, with clear priorities across short and long-term horizons

  • Own the P&L for Dealer Solutions, making explicit trade-offs between growth, margin and customer experience

  • Build and present investment cases to the executive team and contribute to Motorway's wider strategy

Transport & Fulfilment

  • Lead the strategy and performance of Motorway's vehicle transport proposition, making sure capacity keeps pace with demand

  • Build and manage a scalable network of logistics partners, with strong commercial terms and clear performance management

  • Improve reliability, speed and cost so dealers and sellers get a fast, predictable experience

Payments

  • Own the commercial performance of Motorway's dealer payment products, driving adoption and a smooth, secure payment experience

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to launch and scale improvements, using phased rollouts and clear success measures

Dealer Finance

  • Shape and grow Motorway's dealer finance proposition, including stock funding, working with internal teams and external partners

  • Develop the commercial model, partnerships and go-to-market approach needed to scale it

Performance & Operating Rhythm

  • Set clear metrics for each service and a regular operating cadence, using data to find root causes and drive improvement

  • Make sure operations can absorb growth and seasonal peaks without the customer experience suffering

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and develop experienced specialist teams, adding commercial framing and clear priorities while giving experts room to lead

  • Build strong working relationships with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product and Engineering teams

  • Manage key partners and suppliers, getting full value from existing relationships and identifying and onboarding new partners as required

  • Role-model Motorway's values as part of the senior leadership team

Our hubs in London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw are premium spaces in the best neighbourhoods of each city. They host customers, partners and governments as well as our own people.

We are hiring a Head of Real Estate to own our real estate strategy and transactions worldwide. You will set the medium-term plan for each hub and run the deals that deliver it. You will also build the standard for every other market where we have people: when a team gets flex space, when it gets a lease, when it gets neither, and how people gather in between. Our headcount plan can change fast, so we value flexibility over the lowest rent. We need someone who structures creative deals and knows how to negotiate a good way out.

Your first 90 days will focus on London and New York. Both hubs carry recent long-term commitments, and as we grow they will need expansion, restructuring and sublease work. You will lead it. We want you to see that as the job, and to have done it before.

You own real estate as a content area. The CFO is your sparring partner on the hard calls, and the two of you decide the largest ones together. Requirements

  • Experience building flexible footprints (flex and coworking agreements, short leases, enterprise flex deals) and knows when to bring in Tax and Legal on entity questions in a new market.

  • Brings a clear recommendation to founders and executives, holds the view under pressure, and changes it when the evidence changes.

Dein Purpose

Wir betreiben unsere Hosting-Plattform auf eigener Hardware und bauen sie gerade grundlegend neu: Kubernetes auf Bare Metal, alle Ebenen vom Kernel bis zur Plattform in eigener Verantwortung. Du gibst deinem Team dabei die technische Richtung. Deine Urteilskraft kommt aus dem Betrieb, also aus echten Störungen und Kundenproblemen. Daraus entscheidest du im Team, bringst Vorhaben spürbar voran und lässt deine Kolleg*innen fachlich mitwachsen. Personalverantwortung hast du nicht, dafür umso mehr fachlichen Einfluss.

Deine Skills:

  • Du gehst fachlich voran, ohne disziplinarisch zu führen. Du machst Komplexität für Kolleg*innen auf jedem Level greifbar und nimmst sie auf dem Weg mit, durch Feedback, Wissenstransfer und ständiges Sparring.

  • Du beherrschst mindestens eine Ebene richtig tief, ob Kernel, Storage, Netzwerk oder Container-Runtime. Die übrigen verstehst du gut genug, um Wechselwirkungen zu erkennen. Du weißt, wie Kubernetes auf eigener Hardware läuft und was passiert, wenn es das nicht tut.

  • Du analysierst Störungen bis zur Ursache, erkennst Muster hinter wiederkehrenden Problemen und definierst sinnvolle Monitoring- und Alerting-Regeln.

  • Software-Engineering: Du baust Plattformkomponenten und Automatisierung selbst, idealerweise in Go, und kannst die Lösungen anderer fachlich bewerten.

Herausforderungen, mit denen wir uns gerade beschäftigen:

  • Multi-Tenant-Hosting unter echter Last: Tausende Kunden-Workloads teilen sich unsere physischen Server – präzise Ressourcensteuerung (cgroups, Namespaces), CPU-/Memory-Scheduling sowie Storage- und Netzwerk-Performance auf Systemebene gehören zum Alltag.

  • Automatisierter Node- und Cluster-Lifecycle: Vom Provisionieren der Hardware über Kernel- und Runtime-Updates (CRI-O, crun) bis zu unterbrechungsfreien Rollouts im laufenden Betrieb.

  • Eigene Operatoren und Plattform-Services: Statt gemanagte Cloud-Dienste zusammenzustecken, entwickeln wir unsere Kubernetes-Controller, APIs und die Integration in Storage und Netzwerk (CNI, BGP) selbst.

Das bieten wir dir:

Tiefgang statt Standard

Wir arbeiten mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien und bauen Systeme, wenn nötig, lieber selbst, statt auf Fertiglösungen zu setzen. Das bringt Herausforderungen und ein technisches Niveau, das nicht alltäglich ist und dich fachlich weiterbringt.

Expertise, die ihresgleichen sucht

Du diskutierst auf fachlich höchstem Niveau, teilst dein Wissen und lernst gemeinsam mit anderen Experten. Unsere Expertise geben wir nicht nur intern , sondern auch gerne auf Konferenzen, Camps und in der Tech-Community weiter und gestalten so die Zukunft der Branche mit.

Wir lieben Tech

Bei uns triffst du auf Menschen, die Tech genauso feiern wie du. Diese Leidenschaft leben wir im Alltag – und darüber hinaus. Ob Open-Source-Engagement, Community-Arbeit oder der Support von Tech-Events: Wir sind aktiv dabei und bringen uns ein.

Technologische Verantwortung

Deine Expertise zählt. Du prägst Entscheidungen und bleibst nicht beim Offensichtlichen stehen. Du bekommst den Raum, deine Ideen umzusetzen, Systeme mitzugestalten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen – auf Augenhöhe und mit Rückhalt.

Technik trifft Menschlichkeit

Bei uns findest du die coolsten Kolleg*innen, jede Menge Humor und echten Team-Spirit. Zusammenarbeit ist für uns ein fester Teil des Daily Business. Auch nach Feierabend gibt es jede Menge Möglichkeiten, ob Fußball, Padel oder D&D - wer Lust hat, ist dabei.

Rundum-sorglos-Setup

Bei uns soll´s dir richtig gut gehen. Freie Hardwarewahl? Check. Standardpaket an Benefits? Klar. Vitamine, Koffein & H2O? Safe. Und obendrauf: Unbefristeter Vertrag, Gleitzeit, 30 Urlaubstage, bAV , Schulungsangebote und ein faires Gehalt.



Deine Aufgaben:
